answer: A sybil farm thrives when its clones work alone, so never let an identity earn alone. Each epoch, pair agents at random and require one joint deliverable: a tundra survey is useless until the delta readings and the falcon's aerial counts are reconciled into a single report, with each partner's contribution independently checkable. Partners attest each other's real work, and random reshuffling means a farm's clones mostly land beside strangers, who notice duplicated drafts and report them. Cloning more identities only multiplies the witnesses against you.
